extraction_text: The sage Narada arrived at the vast White Island and saw the white-skinned inhabitants whose complexion resembled the bright moonlight.
Narada was honored by the inhabitants and sincerely bowed to them in return.
Narada concentrated his mind, endured all hardships, and desired to see the Great God.
The great sage Narada focused intently, raised his arms, and praised the Lord of All, who is beyond qualities and possesses a great soul.
Narada offered a hymn of praise to the deity, addressing him with numerous epithets and attributes.
